Format: Daggerheart Classes TXT v2

Name: Ranger: Beastbound
Type: Mastery
Domains: Bone,Sage
Short Description: Play the Beastbound if you want to form a deep bond with an animal ally.
Parent Class: Ranger
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Agility
Feature Count: 2
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Advanced Training
Feature 1 Description: Choose two additional level-up options for your companion.
Feature 2 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 2 Name: Loyal Friend
Feature 2 Description: Once per long rest\, when the damage from an attack would mark your companion’s last Stress or your last Hit Point and you’re within Close range of each other\, you or your companion can rush to the other’s side and take that damage instead.

---

Name: Ranger: Beastbound
Type: Specialization
Domains: Bone,Sage
Short Description: Play the Beastbound if you want to form a deep bond with an animal ally.
Parent Class: Ranger
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Agility
Feature Count: 2
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Expert Training
Feature 1 Description: Choose an additional level-up option for your companion.
Feature 2 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 2 Name: Battle-Bonded
Feature 2 Description: When an adversary attacks you while they’re within your companion’s Melee range\, you gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

---

Name: Ranger: Beastbound
Type: Foundation
Domains: Bone,Sage
Short Description: Play the Beastbound if you want to form a deep bond with an animal ally.
Parent Class: Ranger
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Agility
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Companion
Feature 1 Description: You have an animal companion of your choice (at the GM’s discretion). They stay by your side unless you tell them otherwise.\n<p>Take the Ranger Companion sheet. When you level up your character\, choose a level-up option for your companion from this sheet as well.</p>

Name: Warrior: Call of the Brave
Type: Mastery

Parent Class: Warrior
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Camaraderie
Feature 1 Description: Your unwavering bravery is a rallying point for your allies. You can initiate a Tag Team Roll one additional time per session. Additionally\, when an ally initiates a Tag Team Roll with you\, they only need to spend 2 Hope to do so.

Feature 1 Description: When you fail a roll with Fear\, you gain a Hope.
Feature 2 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 2 Name: Battle Ritual
Feature 2 Description: Once per long rest\, before you attempt something incredibly dangerous or face off against a foe who clearly outmatches you\, describe what ritual you perform or preparations you make. When you do\, clear 2 Stress and gain 2 Hope.

Name: Warrior: Call of the Slayer
Type: Mastery
Domains: Blade,Bone
Short Description: Play the Call of the Slayer if you want to strike down adversaries with immense force.
Parent Class: Warrior
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Martial Preparation
Feature 1 Description: You’re an inspirational warrior to all who travel with you. Your party gains access to the Martial Preparation downtime move. To use this move during a rest\, describe how you instruct and train with your party. You and each ally who chooses this downtime move gain a <strong>d6</strong> Slayer Die. A PC with a Slayer Die can spend it to roll the die and add the result to an attack or damage roll of their choice.

Name: Warrior: Call of the Slayer

Domains: Blade,Bone
Short Description: Play the Call of the Slayer if you want to strike down adversaries with immense force.
Parent Class: Warrior
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Weapon Specialist
Feature 1 Description: You can wield multiple weapons with dangerous ease. When you succeed on an attack\, you can <strong>spend a Hope</strong> to add one of the damage dice from your secondary weapon to the damage roll. Additionally\, once per long rest when you roll your Slayer Dice\, reroll any 1s.

---

Name: Warrior: Call of the Slayer
Type: Foundation
Domains: Blade,Bone
Short Description: Play the Call of the Slayer if you want to strike down adversaries with immense force.
Parent Class: Warrior
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Slayer
Feature 1 Description: You gain a pool of dice called Slayer Dice. On a roll with Hope\, you can place a <strong>d6</strong> on this card instead of gaining a Hope\, adding the die to the pool. You can store a number of Slayer Dice equal to your Proficiency. When you make an attack roll or damage roll\, you can spend any number of these Slayer Dice\, rolling them and adding their result to the roll. At the end of each session\, clear any unspent Slayer Dice on this card and gain a Hope per die cleared.

Name: Seraph: Divine Wielder
Type: Mastery
Domains: Splendor,Valor
Short Description: Play the Divine Wielder if you want to dominate the battlefield with a legendary weapon.
Parent Class: Seraph
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Strength
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Sacred Resonance
Feature 1 Description: When you roll damage for your “Spirit Weapon” feature\, if any of the die results match\, double the value of each matching die. For example\, if you roll two 5s\, they count as two 10s.

Feature 2 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 2 Name: Sparing Touch
Feature 2 Description: Once per long rest\, touch a creature and clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress from them.

Name: Sorcerer: Elemental Origin
Type: Mastery
Domains: Arcana,Midnight
Short Description: Play the Elemental Origin if you want to channel raw magic to take the shape of a particular element.
Parent Class: Sorcerer
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Instinct
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Transcendence
Feature 1 Description: Once per long rest\, you can transform into a physical manifestation of your element. When you do\, describe your transformation and choose two of the following benefits to gain until your next rest:\n<ul>\n <li>+4 bonus to your Severe threshold</li>\n <li>+1 bonus to a character trait of your choice</li>\n <li>+1 bonus to your Proficiency</li>\n <li>+2 bonus to your Evasion</li>\n</ul>

Name: Sorcerer: Elemental Origin
Type: Specialization
Domains: Arcana,Midnight
Short Description: Play the Elemental Origin if you want to channel raw magic to take the shape of a particular element.
Parent Class: Sorcerer
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Instinct
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Natural Evasion
Feature 1 Description: You can call forth your element to protect you from harm. When an attack roll against you succeeds\, you can <strong>mark a Stress</strong> and describe how you use your element to defend you. When you do\, roll a <strong>d6</strong> and add its result to your Evasion against the attack.

Feature 1 Description: Choose one of the following elements at character creation: air\, earth\, fire\, lightning\, water.\n<p>You can shape this element into harmless effects. Additionally\, <strong>spend a Hope</strong> and describe how your control over this element helps an action roll you’re about to make\, then either gain a +2 bonus to the roll or a +3 bonus to the roll’s damage.</p>

Name: Witch: Hedge
Type: Mastery
Domains: Sage,Dread
Short Description: Play the Hedge if you want to use your craft to empower yourself and your party.
Parent Class: Witch
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Knowledge
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Circle of Power
Feature 1 Description: Once per rest\, mark a circle on the ground outlining a Very Close area around you\, and place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. While within this circle\, you and your allies gain a +2 bonus to damage thresholds\, attack rolls\, and Evasion. Remove a token each time you or an ally within the circle makes an action roll or evades an attack. This spell lasts until the last token is removed or you exit the circle.

---

Name: Witch: Hedge
Type: Specialization
Domains: Sage,Dread
Short Description: Play the Hedge if you want to use your craft to empower yourself and your party.
Parent Class: Witch
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Knowledge
Feature Count: 2
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Walk Between Worlds
Feature 1 Description: During a moment of calm\, make a <strong>Spellcast Roll (13)</strong>. Once per rest on a success\, you can <strong>mark a Stress</strong> to step beyond the veil of death and converse with any nearby spirits. Place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card and remove one each time a spirit answers a question. When the last token is removed or at the end of the scene\, you return to the Mortal Realm in the same spot you left it.
Feature 2 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 2 Name: Vexing Malison
Feature 2 Description: You have advantage on attacks against <em>Hexed</em> creatures.

---

Parent Class: Witch
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Knowledge
Feature Count: 2
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Herbal Remedies
Feature 1 Description: When you or an ally in the scene clears 1 or more Hit Points or Stress as the result of using a consumable\, increase the number cleared by 1.
Feature 2 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 2 Name: Enchanted Talisman
Feature 2 Description: Once per rest\, you can imbue a small item with your protective essence. <strong> Spend any number of Hope </strong>to place an equal number of tokens on this card. When the person holding the talisman takes damage\, spend a token to reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by one. Clear all tokens from this card when you take a rest.

Name: Rogue: Nightwalker
Type: Mastery
Domains: Midnight,Grace
Short Description: Play the Nightwalker if you want to manipulate shadows to maneuver through the environment.
Parent Class: Rogue
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Finesse
Feature Count: 2
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Fleeting Shadow
Feature 1 Description: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion. You can use your “Shadow Stepper” feature to move within Very Far range.
Feature 2 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 2 Name: Vanishing Act
Feature 2 Description: <strong>Mark a Stress</strong> to become <em>Cloaked</em> at any time. When <em>Cloaked</em> from this feature\, you automatically clear the <em>Restrained</em> condition if you have it. You remain <em>Cloaked</em> in this way until you roll with Fear or until your next rest.

Name: Rogue: Nightwalker

Domains: Midnight,Grace

Parent Class: Rogue
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Finesse
Feature Count: 2
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Dark Cloud
Feature 1 Description: Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong> <strong>(15)</strong>. On a success\, create a temporary dark cloud that covers any area within Close range. Anyone in this cloud can’t see outside of it\, and anyone outside of it can’t see in. You’re considered <em>Cloaked</em> from any adversary for whom the cloud blocks line of sight.
Feature 2 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 2 Name: Adrenaline
Feature 2 Description: While you’re <em>Vulnerable</em>\, add your level to your damage rolls.

Feature 1 Name: Shadow Stepper
Feature 1 Description: You can move from shadow to shadow. When you move into an area of darkness or a shadow cast by another creature or object\, you can <strong>mark a Stress</strong> to disappear from where you are and reappear inside another shadow within Far range. When you reappear\, you are <em>Cloaked</em>.

You’re shunted to the nearest open space if you’re inside an object when the form ends.

Name: Blood Hunter: Order of the Mutant
Type: Foundation
Domains: Blade,Blood
Short Description: 
Parent Class: Blood Hunter
Starting HP: \0
Starting Evasion: \0
Spellcast Trait: Agility
Feature Count: 1
Feature 1 Type: SUBCLASS
Feature 1 Name: Mutagens
Feature 1 Description: You employ mutagenic toxins created to enhance your abilities. When you finish a rest\, you can drink one such toxin to gain its effects\, which last until you finish your next rest. Until this feature ends or you make a different creature your <em>Focus</em>\, you gain the following benefits against your <em>Focus</em>:\n<ul>\n <li>You know precisely what direction they are in.</li>\n <li>When you deal damage to them\, they must mark a Stress.</li>\n <li>When you fail an attack against them\, you can end your Ranger’s Focus feature to reroll your Duality Dice.</li>\n</ul>

Feature 2 Description: If an adversary within Melee range attempts to leave that range\, make a reaction roll using a trait of your choice against their Difficulty. Choose one effect on a success\, or two if you critically succeed:\n<ul>\n <li>They can’t move from where they are.</li>\n <li>You deal damage to them equal to your primary weapon’s damage.</li>\n <li>You move with them.</li>\n</ul>
Feature 3 Type: CLASS
Feature 3 Name: Combat Training
Feature 3 Description: You ignore burden when equipping weapons. When you deal physical damage\, you gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to your level.

You can use a spent die’s value to reduce incoming damage\, add to a roll’s result after the roll is made\, or gain Hope equal to the result. At the end of each session\, clear all unspent Prayer Dice.

Name: Brawler
Type: Base
Domains: Valor,Bone
Short Description: As a brawler\, you’ve honed your body into a lethal weapon\, allowing you to deliverpowerful strikes that intimidate your foes.
Parent Class: \0
Starting HP: 6
Starting Evasion: 10
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 3
Feature 1 Type: HOPE
Feature 1 Name: Square Up
Feature 1 Description: <strong>Spend 3 Hope</strong> to intimidate a target within Close range\, making them temporarily <em>Vulnerable</em>.
Feature 2 Type: CLASS
Feature 2 Name: I Am The Weapon
Feature 2 Description: Your barehanded attacks are as strong as any blade. You have a primary weapon called Brawler’s Strike equipped while you have no other Active Weapons. It uses a trait of your choice\, has Melee range\, and deals <strong>d8+d6</strong> physical damage using your Proficiency (both the d8 and d6 scale off your Proficiency). While this weapon is active\, you gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion.
Feature 3 Type: CLASS
Feature 3 Name: Combo Strike
Feature 3 Description: After rolling damage on a successful attack with a Melee weapon\, you can <strong>mark a </strong><strong>Stress</strong> to start a combo strike. When you do\, roll your Combo Die and note the result\, then continue rolling your Combo Die until the result of your latest roll is lower than the roll that preceded it. You deal extra damage equal to the total of all rolled Combo Die results on this attack. The results can’t be modified by any means.\n<p>Your Combo Die starts as a <strong>d4</strong>. Once per tier\, you can increase your Combo Die by one step as a level advancement option.</p>

Name: Blood Hunter
Type: Base
Domains: Blade,Blood
Short Description: As a blood hunter\, you harness the power of hemocraft—that is\, blood magic—in your relentless pursuit of evil creatures.
Parent Class: \0
Starting HP: 7
Starting Evasion: 9
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 3
Feature 1 Type: HOPE
Feature 1 Name: Blood Maledict
Feature 1 Description: Spend 3 Hope to target a creature within Far range or in a vision from your Grim Psychometry. Until you finish a rest\, take Severe damage\, or use this feature again\, you have advantage on all action rolls against the target.
Feature 2 Type: CLASS
Feature 2 Name: Crimson Rite
Feature 2 Description: You can enchant your strikes with bloodthirsty power at the cost of your vitality. Mark a Hit Point to enchant one of your active weapons. Until you finish your next rest\, that weapon deals physical or magic damage (choose when you use this feature) and an extra 1d6 damage when you hit with it. This extra damage increases to 2d6 at level 5 and 3d6 at level 8.
Feature 3 Type: CLASS
Feature 3 Name: Grim Psychometry
Feature 3 Description: While inspecting a creature\, a location\, or an object within Very Close range\, make a Spellcast Roll (12) . On a success\, mark a Stress to have a vision of the most recent violence involving the target\, and until you finish a rest\, you have advantage on any action roll to recall lore about things in the vision.

Name: Druid
Type: Base
Domains: Sage,Arcana
Short Description: As a druid\, you are a force of nature\, preserving the balance of life and death by channeling the wilds themselves through you.
Parent Class: \0
Starting HP: 6
Starting Evasion: 10
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 3
Feature 1 Type: HOPE
Feature 1 Name: Evolution
Feature 1 Description: <strong>Spend 3 Hope</strong> to transform into a Beastform without marking a Stress. When you do\, choose one trait to raise by +1 until you drop out of that Beastform.
Feature 2 Type: CLASS
Feature 2 Name: Beastform
Feature 2 Description: <strong>Mark a Stress</strong> to magically transform into a creature of your tier or lower from the Beastform list. You can drop out of this form at any time. While transformed\, you can’t use weapons or cast spells from domain cards\, but you can still use other features or abilities you have access to. Spells you cast before you transform stay active and last for their normal duration\, and you can talk and communicate as normal. Additionally\, you gain the Beastform’s features\, add their Evasion bonus to your Evasion\, and use the trait specified in their statistics for your attack. While you’re in a Beastform\, your armor becomes part of your body and you mark Armor Slots as usual; when you drop out of a Beastform\, those marked Armor Slots remain marked. If you mark your last Hit Point\, you automatically drop out of this form.
Feature 3 Type: CLASS
Feature 3 Name: Wildtouch
Feature 3 Description: You can perform harmless\, subtle effects that involve nature—such as causing a flower to rapidly grow\, summoning a slight gust of wind\, or starting a campfire—at will.

Name: Rogue
Type: Base
Domains: Midnight,Grace
Short Description: As a rogue\, you have experience fighting with your blade as well as your wit\, preferring to move quickly and fight quietly.
Parent Class: \0
Starting HP: 6
Starting Evasion: 12
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 3
Feature 1 Type: HOPE
Feature 1 Name: Rogue’s Dodge
Feature 1 Description: <strong>Spend 3 Hope</strong> to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion until the next time an attack succeeds against you. Otherwise\, this bonus lasts until your next rest.
Feature 2 Type: CLASS
Feature 2 Name: Cloaked
Feature 2 Description: Any time you would be <em>Hidden</em>\, you are instead <em>Cloaked</em>. In addition to the benefits of the <em>Hidden</em> condition\, while <em>Cloaked</em> you remain unseen if you are stationary when an adversary moves to where they would normally see you. After you make an attack or end a move within line of sight of an adversary\, you are no longer <em>Cloaked</em>.
Feature 3 Type: CLASS
Feature 3 Name: Sneak Attack
Feature 3 Description: When you succeed on an attack while <em>Cloaked</em> or while an ally is within Melee range of your target\, add a number of <strong>d6s</strong> equal to your tier to your damage roll.

Name: Guardian
Type: Base
Domains: Valor,Blade
Short Description: As a guardian\, you run into danger to protect your party\, keeping watch over those who might not survive without you there.
Parent Class: \0
Starting HP: 7
Starting Evasion: 9
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 2
Feature 1 Type: HOPE
Feature 1 Name: Frontline Tank
Feature 1 Description: <strong>Spend 3 Hope</strong> to clear 2 Armor Slots.
Feature 2 Type: CLASS
Feature 2 Name: Unstoppable
Feature 2 Description: Once per long rest\, you can become <em>Unstoppable</em>. You gain an Unstoppable Die. At level 1\, your Unstoppable Die is a <strong>d4</strong>. Place it on your character sheet in the space provided\, starting with the 1 value facing up. After you make a damage roll that deals 1 or more Hit Points to a target\, increase the Unstoppable Die value by one. When the die’s value would exceed its maximum value or when the scene ends\, remove the die and drop out of <em>Unstoppable</em>. At level 5\, your Unstoppable Die increases to a <strong>d6</strong>.\n<p>While <em>Unstoppable</em>\, you gain the following benefits:</p>\n<ul>\n <li>You reduce the severity of physical damage by one threshold (Severe to Major\, Major to Minor\, Minor to None).</li>\n <li>You add the current value of the Unstoppable Die to your damage roll.</li>\n <li>You can’t be <em>Restrained</em> or <em>Vulnerable</em>.</li>\n</ul>

Name: Warlock
Type: Base
Domains: Dread,Grace
Short Description: As a warlock\, you’ve pledged your life to an otherworldly patron in exchange for extraordinary power.
Parent Class: \0
Starting HP: 5
Starting Evasion: 11
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 3
Feature 1 Type: HOPE
Feature 1 Name: Patron’s Boon
Feature 1 Description: When you fail a roll\, you can <strong>spend 3 Hope</strong> to reroll with advantage.
Feature 2 Type: CLASS
Feature 2 Name: Patron’s Pact
Feature 2 Description: You have committed yourself to a supernatural entity—such as a god\, fae\, or demon—in exchange for power. Write their name on your character sheet\, then work with your GM to determine their sphere of influence (such as Nature\, Chaos\, Wisdom\, Mischief\, Love\, War\, Justice\, or Death). Before making an action roll that relates to your patron’s sphere of influence\, you can <strong>spend a Favor </strong>to call upon their aid\, rolling your Patron Die and adding its result to the total. Your Patron Die starts at a <strong>d6</strong> and increases to a <strong>d8</strong> at level 5.
Feature 3 Type: CLASS
Feature 3 Name: Favor
Feature 3 Description: You start with 3 Favor. You can use a downtime move to show tribute to your patron. Describe how and gain Favor equal to your Spellcast trait. Additionally\, when you succeed on an action roll with Hope\, you can choose to gain a Favor instead of a Hope.

Name: Wizard
Type: Base
Domains: Codex,Splendor
Short Description: As a wizard\, you’ve become familiar with the arcane through the relentless study of grimoires and other tools of magic.
Parent Class: \0
Starting HP: 5
Starting Evasion: 11
Spellcast Trait: \0
Feature Count: 3
Feature 1 Type: HOPE
Feature 1 Name: Not This Time
Feature 1 Description: <strong>Spend 3 Hope</strong> to force an adversary within Far range to reroll an attack or damage roll.
Feature 2 Type: CLASS
Feature 2 Name: Prestidigitation
Feature 2 Description: You can perform harmless\, subtle magical effects at will. For example\, you can change an object’s color\, create a smell\, light a candle\, cause a tiny object to float\, illuminate a room\, or repair a small object.
Feature 3 Type: CLASS
Feature 3 Name: Strange Patterns
Feature 3 Description: Choose a number between 1 and 12. When you roll that number on a Duality Die\, gain a Hope or clear a Stress. You can change this number when you take a long rest.
